panels.description: Colorado CSG facility: Roman sits at a worktable with a hospital treatment schedule, an unapproved T-ALL chemistry file, and a months-scale deterioration marker. His separate bonded TJ stands beside the papers. Keep silent.
Croft places his narrow silver medical-alert bracelet beside the file without touching Roman. Leave the upper third clear.
Croft turns the treatment schedule toward Roman, controlled but exhausted; the schedule date dominates the foreground. Leave upper-left clear.
Roman signs a restricted-access form. His bonded TJ’s green-black display reads LOCAL PARTITION: STATUS PULSE. Roman’s hand remains on the pen after signing. Leave upper-right clear.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: The approved route is too slow.

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: By the time it is approved, there may be no patient left to approve it for.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: I’ll run the chemistry. I keep the records.
